name: record_dependency_decision
description: Records the decision for a reviewed npm package version. Approves or rejects automatically when the route says so, otherwise asks a person through a Human task (User Form dependency_review_form). Then files a GitHub issue with the decision and the brief.

inputParameters.decidedBy: Policy: auto-approved (AI verdict ADOPT, no known advisories, every license allowed, every dependency checked, not deprecated)
Policy: auto-rejected by the workflow's rules (the brief's routing line gives the facts)
